Question Choices: Select. The complete probability list for distinct possible values is 0.25, 0.25, 0.25, and 0.25. Is this a valid distribution? ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: All values lie between 0 and 1.|Their sum is 1.
Solution: For the complete set of distinct possible values of a discrete random variable, each probability is between 0 and 1 inclusive and all probabilities sum to 1. A missing probability is 1 minus the total of the known probabilities. The listed probabilities sum to 1, so the answer is Yes.
